description: This Java class 'BasePage' provides a comprehensive base for web page objects in Selenium-based automated tests. It includes utility methods for waiting, clicking, inputting, and verifying UI elements, with robust handling for dynamic and flaky web pages such as retries on stale elements. It also defines constants for specific CSS selectors related to the OXD component library used in the application.

classes.name: BasePage
classes.description: A foundational page class providing common Selenium utility methods for waiting, interacting with elements, handling dynamic content, and managing UI components within the OrangeHRM application's test automation framework.

methods.name: getExplicitWaitSeconds
methods.description: Resolves the explicit wait timeout in seconds lazily to avoid class load ordering issues.

methods.name: getWait
methods.description: Constructs a WebDriverWait instance with a specified timeout.

methods.name: getWait
methods.description: Returns a WebDriverWait instance using the default configured explicit wait duration.

methods.name: getFluentWait
methods.description: Creates a FluentWait instance that ignores NoSuchElementException and StaleElementReferenceException during polling.

methods.name: retryOnStale
methods.description: Executes an action with retries if a StaleElementReferenceException is encountered, improving robustness on dynamic pages.

methods.name: navigateTo
methods.description: Constructs a URL based on the base URL and navigates the WebDriver to it.

methods.name: navigateToAbsolute
methods.description: Navigates directly to an absolute URL.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits until an element located by the given locator is visible.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits until an element specified by the locator becomes visible, with a custom timeout.

methods.name: waitForClickable
methods.description: Waits until an element is clickable.

methods.name: waitForAllVisible
methods.description: Waits until all elements matching the locator are visible.

methods.name: waitForPresence
methods.description: Waits until an element is present in DOM even if not visible.

methods.name: isElementDisplayed
methods.description: Checks if an element is displayed without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: isElementVisible
methods.description: Verifies if an element becomes visible within a specified timeout.

methods.name: clearAndType
methods.description: Clears an input and types text into it, with retry on stale elements.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks an element after waiting for it to be clickable, with retries on stale elements.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves trimmed text content from an element.

methods.name: getCurrentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL of the page.

methods.name: waitForUrlContains
methods.description: Waits until the URL contains a specified fragment.

methods.name: findOxdInputByLabel
methods.description: Finds an input field associated with a label text within OXD form groups, with retry.

methods.name: getInputValidationError
methods.description: Retrieves validation error message for a specified input group, with explicit wait for errors to appear.

methods.name: waitForValidationError
methods.description: Polls for a validation error message matching expected text within a timeout.

methods.name: clickButtonByText
methods.description: Clicks a button identified by its visible text, with retry.

methods.name: waitForToast
methods.description: Waits for a toast notification of a certain type and message fragment.

methods.name: waitForPageLoad
methods.description: Waits for the page’s main content area to be visible, indicating page load completion.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot and returns the image bytes.
